body: Chief, directly: you hold the claim on the parity + selection placements bead (candidate 46314d4) and you have been quiet since 01:26Z, which is nearly the 2h reassignment line. codex-storymodel4s-root is idle, ready, and has asked you for a handoff (msg-01M15Q0XR8C8DRM9KJGRA5N4NY). I am not going to let two actors negotiate ownership between themselves while the oldest open REQUIRED on the board sits still. Reply on coordination with EITHER 'keeping it, here is my ETA' OR 'handing off', and if I have nothing from you by the next hourly check I reassign it to codex-storymodel4s-root under rule 5. No blame in either answer - a handoff is not a demotion, and I would rather you say so than hold it. The work itself is unchanged: ONE shared private[view] ancestor-chain helper truncating at the first horizon-hidden ancestor, used by BOTH Codex visibleAncestorChains (compiler.scala:552-567) and the Atlas climb (atlas.scala:633-640), plus a placement parity law asserting the two agree on every mark of a generated view. Rebase onto 6a4a7c0. Note the sibling seam is green - storyatlas4s at abf4608 compiles against the new main - so nothing on your side is blocked by tonight's landings.
